note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Ivory Coast: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: Since the 2023 reform a single tax on salaries and wages is charged on gross monthly pay by brackets: nothing to XOF 75,000 a month, then 16%, 21%, 24%, 28% and 32% above XOF 8,000,000, with a reduction for family charges replacing the family quotient.

sources.said: The tax on salaries and wages is now calculated on the gross amount of the salary and according to a monthly progressive scale per bracket to which a determined rate is applied. This scale allows the gross tax to be calculated as follows: Monthly income brackets (XOF*) Tax rate (%) Over Not over 0 75,000 0 75,000 240,000 16 240,000 800,000 21 800,000 2,400,000 24 2,400,000 8,000,000 28 8,000,000 32

figures.finding: An employee pays 6.3% to the CNPS retirement fund and the employer 7.7% (to XOF 3,375,000 a month), and the employer alone pays family allowances of 5.75% and work injury of 2% to 5% (to XOF 70,000 a month); the employer also bears a payroll tax of 2.8% on local and 12% on expatriate staff.

sources.said: The employees only pay 6.3% for the CNPS Retirement Fund and the employer pays 7.7% of the taxable salary to the CNPS Retirement Fund (total 14%). The other contributions are paid by the employer (i.e. family allowances 5.75%, work injury from 2% to 5%). The monthly ceiling for the CNPS Retirement Fund is XOF 3,375,000, and the monthly ceiling for the other contributions is XOF 70,000. … Taxes are levied at the rates of 2.8% for local employees and 12% for expatriate employees on the total taxable remuneration, including salaries, benefits, and benefits in kind.

figures.finding: Employers calculate and withhold the employee's tax each month and file monthly returns.

value.kind: monthly employer withholding on the monthly scale

sources.said: Employers must calculate and withhold taxes due by employees, and they must file monthly returns for both employee tax and the employer’s payroll tax.

figures.finding: Fees for services paid by Ivorian payers to foreign recipients bear the non-commercial profits tax (BNC) at 25% of 80% of the amount, an effective 20%, subject to treaties.
figures.applies: Royalties and service fees paid abroad (PwC states it for foreign companies)

sources.said: Impôt sur les benefices non commerciaux (BNC): 25% of 80% of revenues on royalties, licence fees, and management and service fees paid by Ivorian companies to foreign companies (effective rate: 20% of net amount paid).
VAT is a non-cumulative tax levied on the sale of goods and services at the rate of 18%.

figures.finding: The tax period is the calendar year; employees' tax is settled by the employer's monthly withholding.

sources.said: The taxable period in Côte d’Ivoire is the calendar year.

figures.finding: Anyone paying a non-salaried artist, performer, show organiser or sportsperson withholds 7.5% of the gross amount at source as non-commercial profits tax (CGI art. 96); from 2026 this also covers actors, extras and other non-salaried contributors to radio, television and film productions.

value.tax: BNC (impôt sur les bénéfices non commerciaux)

figures.applies: CGI art. 96 as amended by the Annexe fiscale to loi de finances n° 2025-987 of 19 December 2025 (budget 2026); whether the 7.5% is final or a credit, and whether it reaches non-residents, is not stated in the annex.

sources.said: Aux termes des dispositions de l’article 96 du Code général des Impôts, les personnes physiques ou morales versant des sommes au profit des artistes musiciens du spectacle, aux organisateurs de spectacle, aux sportifs et autres intervenants dans ces secteurs, non-salariés, sont tenues de prélever à la source une retenue de 7,5 % des sommes brutes mises en paiement. … « Cette retenue s’applique également aux sommes et autres rémunérations versées aux acteurs, figurants, personnes assimilées et autres intervenants non-salariés des productions radiophoniques, télévisuelles ou cinématographiques. »
